classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

areas.area: AI requests carry explicit tenant, purpose, permissions, and requester context
areas.requirement: AI request construction fails closed without tenant, purpose, or permissions, and context cannot grant permission or cross tenant boundaries.

areas.area: Models are registered, versioned, routed, and safely replaced
areas.requirement: Models require identity/version/capability metadata, high-risk routing requires approved verified models, and fallback/cascade behavior is explicit.

areas.area: Context trust, retrieval, freshness, and grounding are enforced
areas.requirement: Untrusted content is not treated as system instruction, retrieval is tenant/domain authorized, stale/conflicting sources are visible, and responses require grounding.

areas.area: Reasoning outputs preserve evidence, uncertainty, and verification distinctions
areas.requirement: Reasoning traces avoid chain-of-thought exposure, claims require evidence, uncertainty is estimated, and unsupported outputs are detected.

areas.area: AI risk, approval, escalation, and human authority are explicit
areas.requirement: High-risk and critical AI operations require verification and appropriate approval; low confidence, policy ambiguity, and unknown operations escalate.

areas.area: AI usage budgets, quotas, caching, and circuit protection are bounded
areas.requirement: AI consumption respects budget/quota limits, cache reuse preserves tenant scope, and repeated provider failures open a circuit.

areas.area: AI outputs and learning promotion remain validated and supervised
areas.requirement: Structured output, moderation, age-aware protection, consent, learning gates, release stages, canary limits, kill switches, and telemetry sanitization are enforced.

areas.area: Live provider gateway execution and call audit are wired
areas.requirement: Production model calls traverse the governed gateway, persist call/cost/audit records, and remain operationally observable.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
